016public class SDDRaoBacksAntisFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
017        
018        //protected MarketAPI market;
019        
020        public SDDRaoBacksAntisFactor() {
021                //this.market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("ragnar_complex");

023
024        @Override
025        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
026                return true;
027        }
028        
029        @Override
030        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
031                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
032                        @Override
033                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
034                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
035
036                                if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_knowsAboutHegIntervention")) {
037                                        tooltip.addPara("Orcus Rao has organized the Hegemony's covert backing of the United Front of the Askonian Resistance, providing intel,"
038                                                        + " credits, and weapons for their parallel campaigns of subversion and sabotage against the Sindrian Diktat.",
039                                                        0f, h, "Orcus Rao");
040                                }
041                                else {
042                                        tooltip.addPara("There are rumors that the Hegemony is covertly backing the United Front of the Askonian Resistance, providing intel,"
043                                                + " credits, and weapons for their parallel campaigns of subversion and sabotage against the Sindrian Diktat.\n\nThe name Orcus Rao is"
044                                                + " whispered in association with covert shipments of arms, supplies, and credits.",
045                                                8f, h, "Orcus Rao");
046                                }
047                                
048                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksHegemony")) {
049                                        tooltip.addPara("Horus Yaribay is channelling support to Askonian rebels in close coordination with suspected Hegemony covert action.",
050                                                        8f, h, "Horus Yaribay");
051                                }
052                                else if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_knowsAboutHegIntervention")) {
053                                        tooltip.addPara("Horus Yaribay is channelling support to Askonian rebels in close coordination with Orcus Rao's covert campain.",
054                                                        8f, h, "Horus Yaribay");
055                                }
056                                
057                                boolean _disruption = false;
058                                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("ragnar_complex");
059                                if(market != null) {
060                                        Industry ind1 = market.getIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE);
061                                        Industry ind2 = market.getIndustry(Industries.SPACEPORT);
062                                        Industry ind3 = market.getIndustry(Industries.BATTLESTATION);
063                                        if (ind1 != null && ind1.isDisrupted()) _disruption = true;
064                                        if (ind2 != null && ind2.isDisrupted()) _disruption = true;
065                                        if (ind3 != null && ind3.isDisrupted()) _disruption = true;
066                                }
067                                
068                                //System.out.println("_disruption: " + _disruption); 
069
070                                if(_disruption) {
071                                        if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_knowsAboutHegIntervention")) {
072                                                tooltip.addPara("Recent attacks on Ragnar Complex have disrupted the Hegemony's covert intervention in the Second Askonia Crisis.",
073                                                        8f, h, "Ragnar Complex");
074                                        }
075                                        else {
076                                                tooltip.addPara("Recent attacks on Ragnar Complex are rumored to have disrupted the suspected Hegemony covert intervention in the Second Askonia Crisis.",
077                                                        8f, h, "Ragnar Complex");
078                                        }
079                                }
080                        }       
081                };
082        }
083
084        @Override
085        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
086//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
087                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
088        }
089        
090        @Override
091        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
092                int _amount = SDDPoints.RAO_EFFECT;
093                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("ragnar_complex");
094                Industry ind1 = market.getIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE);
095                Industry ind2 = market.getIndustry(Industries.SPACEPORT);
096                Industry ind3 = market.getIndustry(Industries.BATTLESTATION);
097                if (ind1 != null && ind1.isDisrupted()) _amount -= 2;
098                if (ind2 != null && ind2.isDisrupted()) _amount -= 2;
099                if (ind3 != null && ind3.isDisrupted()) _amount -= 2;
100                
101                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksHegemony")) {
102                        _amount += SDRPoints.YARIBAY_SUPPORT;
103                }
104                return _amount;
105        }
106
107        @Override
108        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
109                if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_knowsAboutHegIntervention")) {
110                        return "Orcus Rao's secret war";
111                }
112                else {
113                        return "Covert Hegemony? intervention";
114                }
115        }
116        
117        @Override
118        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
119                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
120                return Misc.getGrayColor();
121        }
